rationale: GMED gapped down ~9% on mixed earnings (revenue miss, international weakness) and is currently sitting at 24% of today's range near the low, with price below both VWAP ($74.74) and the 9-EMA ($74.51), suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the last few 1-minute candles show a deceleration in downward momentum with very low volume, making directional conviction difficult. With 4 working short orders already consuming ~12% of buying power and the stock in a post-earnings digestion phase with no clear technical setup forming, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
